sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System Handing Over Repeal Act 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 205
ACT XV OF 205
North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System (Handing
Over) (Repeal) Act 2005
An Act to repeal the N.-W.F.P.
Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) Act, 1986
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 24th December, 2005]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System (Handing Over)
(Repeal) Act, 2005.
(2) it
shall come into force at once.

Repeal of N.-W.F.P. Act No.VIII of 1987

ACT XV OF 205
ACT XV OF 205
North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System (Handing
Over) (Repeal) Act 2005
An Act to repeal the N.-W.F.P.
Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) Act, 1986
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 24th December, 2005]
2. Repeal of N.-W.F.P. Act No.VIII of 1987.---The N.-W.F.P. Agricultural Research System (Handing
Over) Act, 1986 (N.-W.F.P.) Act No.VIII of 1987) is

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System Handing Over Repeal Act 2005
sections.description:
Savings

ACT XV OF 205
ACT XV OF 205
North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Research System (Handing
Over) (Repeal) Act 2005
An Act to repeal the N.-W.F.P.
Agricultural Research System (Handing Over) Act, 1986
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 24th December, 2005]
3. Savings.---(1)
Notwithstanding the repeal of the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural
Research System (Handing Over) Act, 1986 (NWFP Act No.VIII
of 1987), any scheme prepared or executed, research made contract entered into,
suit instituted, rights acquired, claims made, legal or administrative
'proceedings or action taken under the said Act shall be deemed to have been
validly prepared or executed entered into, instituted, acquired, made or taken.
(2) The assets and liabilities,
if any, acquired under the repealed Act shall henceforth be the assets and
liabilities of the Agriculture Department.
